title: Reproducibility package: THEOS-2 land-cover segmentation under controlled evaluation (Paper 1)
description: Code, configuration, pre-registration, spatial split definition, reference masks, per-run training logs, per-tile evaluation results and analysis scripts behind the article 'Split, scene and reference definition outweigh training choices in deep land-cover segmentation: evidence from 360 controlled runs on THEOS-2 imagery'. THEOS-2 imagery is not included (GISTDA licence).
